name: Jolanda Simon
story: In an August 2000 MapInfo-L exchange, Hurunui District Council IT Officer Jolanda Simon described a MapInfo 6 Hotlink workflow in which 78 mapped features opened separate MapInfo workspaces. The council was working across Windows 2000 and Windows 95/98 computers. The exchange gives a glimpse of day-to-day council GIS work at the time.

sources.label: Jolanda Simon, ‘Hotlink tool in MI v6’, MapInfo-L technical correspondence, 22 August 2000
